Entities / Places / Cabinet Of Morsani

The Cabinet of Morsani

Overview

The Cabinet of Morsani is in the Velo Quarter, where Calveno stops enforcing its normal rules about closing hours. It sells magical and exotic items of uncertain provenance. Prospero Morsani insists everything in the shop has a previous owner and he knows the story. The stories always end before the interesting part.

At a Glance

FieldDetail
TypeMagical curio and exotic item dealer
Location[[calveno
Operated By[[prospero-morsani
Public AccessOpen at irregular hours; lanterns signal availability
Known ForItems of unusual provenance, stories without endings, stock that varies week to week

Description

Lanterns on at all hours — outside, inside, several on chains over the canal-facing window. The shop is narrow but unexpectedly deep; the shelves go high and curve at the back where the original wall has been extended into a space that doesn’t quite fit the building’s exterior.

People & Operations

Proprietor: Prospero Morsani — A gnome whose theatrical impulse has hardened into identity over a very long life, trailing rings on every finger. Greets customers by name if he has met them before and by an accurate physical description if he hasn’t. Every item has a previous owner and he knows the story; the stories just never get to the point.

Stock

Stock turns over irregularly. Morsani does not produce a static catalogue.

  • 400 gp — Compass of the Drowned — “The previous owner was a navigator who — well. The compass works.”
  • 250 gp — Ringmaker’s Regret — “Two fifty, or a trade if what you’re offering has a sufficiently interesting story.”
  • 90 gp — Preserved specimen, unknown origin — “I have documentation of the previous three owners. The first one is the interesting part.”
  • 80 gp — Salt Lantern — “Came through Port Tidefall. The captain who brought it — there’s a story there.”
  • 180 gp — The Uncharted Coast — “Two hundred miles of coastline on no published chart. The surveyor’s notes are — the price is one eighty.”

Access & Security

The lanterns outside indicate whether Morsani is in. When all lanterns are lit, walk in. The door is never locked while he is there.
